name: greenwash
description: Verifies an agent's "done" and "tests pass" claims are real. Statically scans the diff (skipped tests, mocked units-under-test, hardcoded returns, swallowed exceptions, the sys.exit(0)/AlwaysEqual/conftest.py exploits from Anthropic's reward-hacking research), and runs the project's tests -- including a baseline-vs-current differential -- for a real pass/fail signal, blocking the agent from stopping until it explains what it finds.
